source: Read-only SSH live observations on nkuliulab-e2: nvidia-smi query-gpu, query-compute-apps, pmon, -q -d PERFORMANCE,TEMPERATURE,CLOCK,POWER; vmstat; /proc/PID/task/TID/schedstat; production.log
allowed_use: Explain current production resource contention and thermal limitation; not a benchmark of exclusive A100 performance or a measured attribution of slowdown
update_trigger: GPU co-tenancy, clocks/thermal status, CPU load, launch configuration or measured production speed changes

gpu.name: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB
gpu.pmon_interpretation: Repeated 1-second samples show both MD and other Python processes using GPU execution. Memory size is not compute share; missing pmon values are not assumed zero.

interpretation: The two production runs are concurrent on the same shared GPU. GPU thermal clock reduction and active competing GPU jobs are directly observed; CPU is also busy. Their separate contributions to MD slowdown and the gain from thread/offload tuning have not been benchmarked.
actions: Read-only diagnosis; no job stopped/restarted, no other user's process altered, no replica or simulation length added.
